title: Misty Psyduck 193/182
caption: Misty's Psyduck has the exact face I make when somebody explains market value to me at brunch. I know people want the big dramatic cards, but this confused little duck wins. Are you keeping it or are you WRONG? 💛

title: Psyduck 175/165
caption: Psyduck wandering through this card like he forgot why he went into the room. Honestly the most relatable art in 151. Give me your best argument for a cuter card in that set; I have time. 🦆

title: Cleffa 202/197
caption: Cleffa got an entire cosmic event for being approximately four inches tall. Correct decision. I would put this in a binder ahead of cards worth ten times as much, and yes, I know how that sounds. ✨

title: Eevee 188/167
caption: This Eevee has a whole squad and somehow still manages to be the main character. If you could only keep ONE Eevee card in your binder, does this make the cut? Choose carefully, I'm judging. 🦊

title: Slowpoke 204/198
caption: Slowpoke is just out here living at a speed my therapist keeps recommending. This card is a tiny vacation. Who else collects cards mostly because they'd like to move into the artwork? 🌿

title: Magikarp 203/193
caption: Everybody calls Magikarp useless and then this card shows up looking like a museum piece. I need a formal apology from the entire Pokémon community. Best Magikarp art ever, or are we fighting? 🐟

title: Paldean Wooper 221/193
caption: Paldean Wooper looks like a chocolate-covered problem and I mean that with love. This is the sort of card I buy twice because one has to live on my desk. What Pokémon do you irrationally hoard? 🤎

title: Wiglett 206/198
caption: Wiglett has the energy of somebody overhearing gossip from three rooms away. No thoughts, just a very long neck and excellent timing. Cute or deeply unsettling? I can accept both. 👀

title: Drowzee 210/198
caption: This Drowzee art feels like a dream I would describe badly and nobody would believe me. It's weird, it's gorgeous, and I'm still deciding if it can be trusted. Does weird art beat cute art for you? 🌙

title: Ralts 211/198
caption: Ralts is doing its tiny errands and I am emotionally invested. A card doesn't need a giant explosion to be worth staring at. Which Pokémon has the best everyday-life artwork? 🛒

title: Kirlia 212/198
caption: Kirlia is giving quiet main-character moment while the rest of us have 37 notifications. The Ralts-to-Gardevoir art story deserves its own binder page. Do you keep evolution lines together or are you chaotic? 💃

title: Gardevoir ex 245/198
caption: The ending to that Ralts and Kirlia sequence hits harder than some actual movies. I came for cute cardboard and now I'm having feelings. What's another evolution line that tells a whole story? 🥲

title: Fuecoco 201/193
caption: Fuecoco looks like he brought exactly one brain cell on this outing and left it in the car. Perfect Pokémon, no notes. Which starter has the strongest 'I would babysit this disaster' energy? 🍎

title: Crocalor 202/193
caption: Crocalor is the awkward middle school photo of the Fuecoco family and I will defend him with my life. Middle evolutions get treated so unfairly. Name one that deserves more love. 🔥

title: Sprigatito 196/193
caption: Sprigatito is cute, but also looks like it would knock your favorite mug off the counter and blame gravity. Cat owners, tell me I'm wrong. 🌱🐈

title: Floragato 197/193
caption: Floragato went from adorable kitten to 'I know a guy' in one evolution. It's the attitude for me. Which Pokémon had the biggest personality jump between cards? 💚

title: Quaxly 206/193
caption: Quaxly's hair is more organized than my whole life. I respect the commitment, even if he absolutely judges the way I fold laundry. Which starter is the biggest diva? 🫧

title: Quaxwell 207/193
caption: Quaxwell is posing like the entire sidewalk is a runway. You know what? It is. I want a binder page dedicated to Pokémon who think they're famous. Who gets the first slot? 🕺

title: Maushold 226/193
caption: Four mice, one card, and somehow they have a better group photo than my family has ever taken. Is Maushold cute or a tiny organized crime unit? Please provide evidence. 🐭

title: Frigibax 208/193
caption: Frigibax looks like he woke up grumpy and somebody put him in a beautiful painting anyway. That's range. Tell me your favorite Pokémon that is adorable against its will. 🧊

title: Baxcalibur 210/193
caption: I started with cute little Frigibax and ended up with this absolute refrigerator of a dragon. Growth is weird. Do you collect the entire evolution line, even when the final form changes the vibe? 🐉

title: Sudowoodo 219/193
caption: Sudowoodo is pretending to be a tree with the confidence of a man in a fake mustache. The artwork makes the bit even better. What's your favorite Pokémon whose whole existence is a joke? 🌳

title: Charmander 168/165
caption: Charmander in Pokémon 151 has me wanting to organize an entire binder page around one tiny fire lizard. Be honest: are you a Charmander person, or do you pretend to be above starter favoritism? 🔥

title: Bulbasaur 166/165
caption: Bulbasaur people never shut up about Bulbasaur. Unfortunately they are right a lot of the time. This 151 art is my exhibit A. Which starter gets your forever loyalty? 🌱

title: Squirtle 170/165
caption: Squirtle has always looked like a kid who just discovered sunglasses and made it everybody's problem. This 151 card goes straight into the cute binder. Team Squirtle, report in. 🐢

title: Poliwhirl 176/165
caption: Poliwhirl in the rain is proof that a quiet scene can absolutely steal a set. No giant laser beams required. Which card would you hang on your wall even if it were worth nothing? ☔

title: Dragonair 181/165
caption: Dragonair is out here looking like an ancient lake spirit and I'm supposed to care about pull rates? Please. Is this the prettiest card in 151, or do you have a counteroffer? 💙

title: Tangela 178/165
caption: Tangela is basically a pair of eyes lost in craft-store yarn, and somehow this art makes that elegant. I love when a card changes my mind about a Pokémon. Who did that for you? 🧶

title: Mr. Mime 179/165
caption: I am willing to admit this Mr. Mime art is charming. I am NOT willing to invite Mr. Mime into my house. Which Pokémon has a card you love even though the Pokémon scares you a little? 🎭

title: Omanyte 180/165
caption: Omanyte is just a happy little fossil living its best ancient life. If it had a fan club, I would probably pay dues. What's the cutest fossil Pokémon, and why is everybody arguing already? 🐚

title: Pikachu 173/165
caption: This Pikachu card is a whole neighborhood hangout and I keep spotting new little details. I love busy art when it actually rewards you for looking. Which card makes you stop and zoom in? ⚡

title: Ninetales 199/197
caption: Ninetales looks like it knows three secrets about me and will reveal them when it's convenient. Beautiful? Yes. Trustworthy? Absolutely not. Which Pokémon card feels the most magical? ✨

title: Pidgey 207/197
caption: Pidgey spent years being the bird you walked past to get somewhere else. Then this art showed up and made me apologize. Which overlooked Pokémon got the glow-up it deserved? 🐦

title: Pidgeotto 208/197
caption: Pidgeotto is the middle evolution that actually understood the assignment. The Pidgey line makes such a good binder sequence. Are matching evolution pages cute or am I too deep in this hobby? 🪶

title: Pidgeot ex 225/197
caption: Pidgeot ex closes the little Pidgey art story like the final scene of an extremely dramatic bird movie. I support it. Best three-card evolution display, yes or no? 🪽

title: Gloom 198/197
caption: Gloom looks like it smells terrible but has a very nice personality. I can't explain why this card makes me protective of it. Which Pokémon do you love despite its obvious red flags? 🌸

title: Palafin 200/197
caption: Palafin's whole superhero thing is so extra, and then this card commits to the bit completely. Respect. Which Pokémon has the most ridiculous lore that you still adore? 🦸

title: Bellibolt 201/197
caption: Bellibolt is a walking stress ball with false eyes. The real eyes are the tiny dots and I need everyone to sit with that for a second. Still cute, or did I ruin it? 🐸

title: Larvitar 203/197
caption: Larvitar looks like a tiny dinosaur who got distracted on the way to becoming everyone's favorite monster. This is the exact stage I want in my binder. What baby Pokémon beats its evolution? 🦖

title: Houndour 204/197
caption: Houndour has absolutely never done anything wrong. Look at that face. If you disagree, I need a detailed written statement and you have until Friday. 🖤🐕

title: Snom 168/162
caption: Snom is a little snow-covered comma and I would cross a room to protect it. The hype for Snom is entirely justified, actually. What tiny Pokémon has you acting unreasonable? ❄️

title: Wugtrio 224/091
caption: Wugtrio is three suspicious noodles in a trench coat, except they forgot the coat. I can't decide if this belongs in the cute binder or the cursed binder. Where are you filing it? 😂

title: Palafin 225/091
caption: Another Palafin card, another reminder that this dolphin takes its secret identity more seriously than most superheroes. Are we calling this cute, cool, or too much? I vote all three. 🐬

title: Pawmi 226/091
caption: Pawmi looks like the plushie version of itself, which feels like cheating. I still want six. What Pokémon would you collect in every single card variation without getting bored? 🧡

title: Ditto 201/091
caption: Shiny Ditto is the color of a tiny piece of sky and still has that blank face. An icon of doing absolutely nothing with confidence. Do you like regular Ditto purple or shiny Ditto blue better? 💙

title: Lickitung 180/162
caption: Lickitung always makes me a little uncomfortable and this card is somehow delightful anyway. That's artistic talent. What's the strangest Pokémon you still insist is cute? 👅

title: Gastly 177/162
caption: Gastly art can go creepy or adorable and this one is having far too much fun with both. Ghost collectors, what's the card that made you pick a spooky favorite? 👻

title: Cinccino 183/162
caption: Cinccino looks so clean and put together that I'm worried it would silently judge my desk. Honestly fair. Which Pokémon would be impossible to live with because it has standards? 🧼

title: Chatot 181/162
caption: Chatot looks ready to repeat the worst thing I said this week in front of company. Beautiful card, terrible roommate. Which Pokémon would cause the most drama in a group chat? 🎵

title: Cutiefly 172/162
caption: Cutiefly is barely bigger than a crumb and still manages to take over the whole card. I collect tiny Pokémon with outsized confidence. Who is the smallest one you'd defend in an argument? 🧚
